## Outcome
A simple deploy-time extension protocol, extracted from one real plugin (a signup form), lets a plugin contribute backend models/mutations, a newsroom panel, and a Markus directive with a self-contained web component on static pages.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 7 (Extension points, later).

## Checklist
- [ ] SignupEntry model (not guest-readable)
- [ ] Guest submitSignup custom mutation: validation, honeypot, WAF rate rule
- [ ] Newsroom list + CSV export panel (editor/admin)
- [ ] :::signup directive via Markus Registry.register(DirectiveSpec) emitting <papyrus-signup> placeholder + versioned script; web component uploaded by project_all
- [ ] Extract the protocol (backend contribution through site-backend.ts like features switches; resolver waves; pinned versions; no compatibility shims) into docs

## Acceptance
- A page with :::signup on a test site renders statically; submitting the form creates a SignupEntry visible in the newsroom panel; 21st request per minute from one IP is blocked.

## Out of scope
A plugin registry, runtime hot-plugging, a second plugin.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M8 (public surface, WAF pattern) and M1 (projection Lambda).

## Risk
Abuse of guest writes; mitigated by WAF, validation, non-public storage.

## Estimate
6-10 agent-hours.

## Outcome
Static Markus sites gain dynamic features without losing static SEO: first, generated JSON files written by the projector (search index, latest items, tags, feed); later, a narrow, throttled guest write pattern.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 6 (Public GraphQL surface for static sites).

## Verified today
Guest (identity pool unauthenticated) can read only PublishedItem, PublishedMediaAsset, PublishedEdition, PublishedEditionItem, PublishedCategorySet, PublishedCategory and media/*; no guest write anywhere; API key mode enabled but unused by any rule.

## Checklist
- [ ] Projector writes /_data/latest.json, /_data/search-index.json, /_data/tags.json and an optional feed on every relevant projection
- [ ] Review guest-readable PublishedItem fields (metadata, editorial, layout) for anything that must never be public
- [ ] Later: WAF web ACL on AppSync with a rate-based rule; pattern for a guest custom mutation (validation, size limits, honeypot, non-public target model)

## Acceptance
- curl https://<site>/_data/search-index.json returns current titles after an edit (within the M4 freshness bound).
- Schema test: no guest rule on any non-Published model.

## Out of scope (YAGNI for now)
Subscriptions, browser GraphQL reads, comments, a custom API domain.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M3.

## Risk
Guest writes are a new abuse surface; deferred until M9 needs them.

## Estimate
3-4 agent-hours (JSON) + 3-6 (WAF and guest mutation pattern).
